_meta.note: From the farm details form (R-1), section 8, except the keys in placeholderKeys, which are proposed for the team to check. maxPerDoseMl and max24hMl are the form's. mixWaitS is 10 s: the agriculture team confirmed the nutrients mix into the reservoir in 5 to 10 s (the form said 10 min); lengthen it if the rig shows EC and pH still moving after 10 s, since the dose's after values are read then. ecCeiling is the top of each zone's EC/TDS target range (TDS ppm / 500, the probes' 0.5 factor): the dose review never doses above it. phMin and phMax are the pH target range widened by 0.3 each way, so a reading just outside the target doesn't block every dose (the rig has no pH-down pump). minReservoirPctToDose is the low level, 20 % of each zone's 90 L main tank = 18 L (review of #82). maxDurationS is the rig's longest single dose (600 s); tolerancePct is the contract default.
